design-system/src/components/forms-and-i.why: EXEMPT, BUT WORTH A LOOK — the UNSELECTED star. It is the track of the rating rather than the value, and WCAG 1.4.11 exempts inactive components; the selected stars carry the meaning. Recorded rather than dismissed because 1.62:1 is faint enough that the empty half of a 2-of-5 rating is nearly invisible, and whether that reads is a design call.
